QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Re-acquiring Alcadno Cape
QuestInfo.0: Oh no...! I lost #t1102136#, the one item that proves that I'm a member of Alcadno. What should I do? I better go talk to the president of the Alcadno Society, #p2111001#.
QuestInfo.2: I got Alcadno Cape again. Without it, I can't be accepted as an Alcadno. I better not lose it again.
QuestInfo.1: #p2111001# says he can make you the cape if you bring him the materials. As long as he can make it, that's no problem! You just need #b#t4000021##k and #b10,000 Mesos#k.

1.0: Since you have brought all the items, I'll make you another Alcadno Cape, but... please remember this. Wearing Alcadno Cape signifies that you are a member of Alcadno. The cape is also laden with a special spell. Please don't lose it. It can only be made once every 3 days.

yes.0: As a proud member of Alcadno, you should handle the cape with utmost pride and care.
